# Difficulty rewards

Seasons and Tournaments pay match coins and XP by the difficulty of the fixture. Coins below are for account level 1; each level above 1 adds 2% (level 10 earns 118%). XP is the base (win 100, draw 60, loss 30) times the XP scale.

| Difficulty | Win coins | Draw coins | Loss coins | XP scale | Win XP | Draw XP | Loss XP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beginner | 2,250 | 1,350 | 750 | 100% | 100 | 60 | 30 |
| Amateur | 2,975 | 1,775 | 1,000 | 114% | 114 | 68 | 34 |
| Semi-Pro | 3,850 | 2,300 | 1,275 | 128% | 128 | 76 | 38 |
| Professional | 5,075 | 3,025 | 1,700 | 142% | 142 | 85 | 42 |
| World Class | 7,100 | 4,250 | 2,375 | 163% | 163 | 97 | 48 |
| Legendary | 9,000 | 5,400 | 3,025 | 179% | 179 | 107 | 53 |
| Ultimate | 10,100 | 6,050 | 3,375 | 187% | 187 | 112 | 56 |

## Season coins by difficulty

A season pays the average of these values over its 10 scheduled fixtures (see [Seasons](seasons.md) for each competition).

| Difficulty | Relegation | Stay up | Promotion | Title |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beginner | — | 4,500 | 22,500 | 28,500 |
| Amateur | 5,250 | 6,750 | 29,500 | 38,000 |
| Semi-Pro | 6,000 | 9,250 | 37,000 | 48,750 |
| Professional | 8,000 | 12,750 | 46,750 | 62,750 |
| World Class | 11,250 | 18,750 | 60,750 | 87,500 |
| Legendary | 14,750 | 24,750 | 71,000 | 112,250 |
| Ultimate | 17,000 | 28,500 | 79,500 | 128,000 |
